_comment: Tier-2 for febio::biphasic_fsi#3. <solver type="fluid-FSI"/> with no children inherits the skyline default: the deck reads SUCCESS and then aborts with the matrix-format ERROR box, 0 completed steps, error termination, exit 1 (matched on the fragment 'does not support the requested' because the box wraps). Separately, <linear_solver type="schur"/> is refused at parse with 'Component "linear_solver" needs to have property "A_solver" defined'. Positive control: the shipped template, unmodified, which reaches normal termination — so the message is attributable to the single thing that was changed. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'biphasic_fsi_solver=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
